title: I made a game for the UnrealEngine MegaJam (An AI focused GameJam), if you play it please let me know!
author: Sheru7000

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Sheru7000 could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

comments.author: miomidas
comments.body: I watched the trailer and the overall concept seems creative but the animations and the fights look janky as hell, also the conversation with the wife seems buggy

replies.author: Sheru7000
replies.body: it very much is, part of the jam was to use AI only, Iam very unhappy with my final combat system and the way it looks and works too, but those are the AI generated animations we got.... The part I was surprised by was how good and cheap AI voice is!

replies.author: miomidas
replies.body:
I feel like, with some refinement, this has a lot of potential

Reminds me of deathloop a bit
